note: IN-REPRESENTATION (contraction knots + reflexes ON, ri 1; NOT open-loop; knot content distilled from the ideal-control programs at the 6 grid locations): S10 = the S3 swing (balanced S2c swing + zero-initialised drive time profile) retuned by as-run sep-CMA over 50 tunables: the 41 of the P95 retune (drive profile, aim-correction gains, fire and train timing, arm/reflex gains) plus 9 leg and stride parameters found by a one-at-a-time scan (leg_swing_kp/kd, stride_at, train_legs and its ease, drv_stride, lift_at, step_delay, dur_stride), on 24 fresh practice pitches (seeds 7400-7423, never an arena seed) with a launch-angle cost of 0.10 per degree beyond 8 off 20, an aim margin of 1.0 per cm beyond 1.5 and the bat_flow term anchored at 2.35. Validation paired against S3 on this body, as run: 48 fresh pitches seeds 4000-4047 26.71 vs 26.57 m/s (better on 44 of 48), 48 untouched pitches seeds 6000-6047 26.83 vs 26.70 (better on 40 of 48), 48/48 hits, bat_flow 2.30-2.34 vs 2.31-2.37; ball quality about equal (fair 41-44 of 48 vs 44-46, mean launch 14-22 deg). params/bat_r2_s10.txt, controller bin/challengers/bat_r2-t8
